**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve decoded escapes when rebuilding includes**

In the remark-GFM/Docusaurus path, when an HTTPS-bearing include also has the double-backslash escaped-quote parameter form already exercised at `server/fixtures/includes-vars.mdx:21`, replacing the children with the raw VFile slice bypasses the Markdown parser's first escape-decoding pass. The normal one-text-node path gives `resolveParamValue` one backslash to remove, while this path gives it two, so a placeholder inside a fenced-code partial retains a visible backslash before each quote; adding a URL parameter therefore changes the rendered code. Rebuild from decoded child/link text, or normalize the raw escapes before resolution.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
